item.title: Ulster District Electoral Divisions/Wards 1994 source files
item.subtitle: Electoral Divisions / Phelim Birch
item.description: Electoral divisions for the three Ulster counties in the Republic of Ireland (Cavan, Donegal, Monaghan), 1994. Per the IDB boundary-change log, no DED changes are recorded for these three counties from 1921 onwards, so this file is the canonical ROI Ulster ED dataset.
